errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are not consistently spaced in 5-year intervals. The first interval is 6 years (1984 to 1990), while the subsequent intervals are 5 years.

errors.text_span: The blue line with circles begins at about 16% in 1984, decreases gradually to around 8% in 2010, and then stabilizes.
errors.evidence: This description contains multiple errors. The line starts at approximately 17%, not 16%. The decrease is not gradual; there is a sharp drop after 2010, reaching about 8% around 2014, not 2010. In 2010, the value is still around 14%.
The blue line with triangles starts at approximately 13% in 1984, not 10%.
The blue line with squares starts at approximately 25% in 1984, not 23%.

errors.text_span: The green dotted line starts at about 9% in 1984
errors.evidence: The green dotted line (Ländliche Regionen, Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser) starts at approximately 12.5% in 1984, not 9%. The value 9% corresponds to the starting point of the solid green line.

errors.text_span: The green line representing "Ländliche Regionen, Mehrfamilienhäuser" is not visible as it is likely overlapping with the green dotted line.
errors.evidence: This statement is false. The solid green line for this category is clearly visible throughout the chart, starting at approximately 9% and rising to about 11% by 2020. The description fails to describe this line and instead incorrectly claims it is not visible.
